reference.title: Choose a PDF template
reference.shortdesc: A PDF template sets the page size, margins, text size, cover, contents and running header and footer of every publication. Pick one of four built-in templates with pdf in opend.config.yaml, and change any of its settings.

strow.stentry: The default. A4 portrait, normal margins, 10.5 pt text, a title page with the title in the accent colour, contents, each chapter on a new page, the publication title in the header and page numbers in the footer.
US Letter with wide margins, a banner title page (a full-width band in the accent colour), the site title in the header and {title} · Release {release} in the footer.
Dense A4 for printing: narrow margins, 9.5 pt text, no title page (a title block opens the first page) and chapters that run on.
Pocket-sized A5 in a serif face, with a plain left-aligned title page, no header and the publication title in the footer.

property.propdesc: The built-in template the other settings change. Default standard. Every other setting defaults to the template's own value.
Which way up the page is.
Page margins: 20/18 mm, 14/12 mm or 26/25 mm (top and bottom / sides).

property.propvalue: default, system, humanist, serif, rounded, mono
property.propdesc: The body font. default follows the site theme. Only fonts installed on the server that prints the PDF are used.
The title page. none puts a title block at the top of the first page instead.
An extra line on the cover, such as Confidential.
Print the contents after the cover.
Start every top-level chapter, and the first page after the contents, on a new page.
Text at the foot of every page, before the page number, with the same placeholders.
Print page / pages at the foot of every page.

example.title: Example
example.codeblock: pdf: template: report pageSize: A4 # the report layout, on A4 paper coverNote: Confidential: for customers only footer: '{title} · {date}'
example.p: Quote text that starts with {: unquoted, YAML reads it as a mapping. A setting the template does not know, or a value it does not allow, is reported as invalid-config. Print CSS goes in the project theme; see .
On a hosted site, staff can choose a template on the admin console's Appearance page instead. Saved there, it replaces these settings for every release until it is reset; see .
